sloka: हेत्वर्थयुक्तं विधिवत् श्रेयस्करमदारुणम् ।विभीषणेनाभिहितं न कृतं हेतुमत्त्वया ।। ६.११४.७७ ।।
transliteration: hetvarthayuktaṁ vidhivat śreyaskaramadāruṇam ।vibhīṣaṇenābhihitaṁ na kṛtaṁ hetumattvayā ।। 6.114.77 ।।

translations.english: "You have taken away the good and evil deeds done by your death. I'm thinking of myself and wailing."
